details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Elemental: magical HP healing applies; cannot swallow potions. Printed immunities only.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Debris forms rings around a place untouched by rain.

**Purpose:** Break a confinement that has lasted too long.

**Tactics and retreat:** Push intruders from an exposed ridge; strike with lightning when they spread out.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Leave the ridge and break the binding stones from sheltered ground.

**Habitat:** Mountain; storm coast · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A shattered binding ring worth 40 coins as salvage, once.

**Summoning:** Elemental 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/summons/storm-column.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-storm-column


**Category:** Elemental · **Role:** Area displacer · **CV:** 38

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** lightning

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.65

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.5 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.404, O=6.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [elemental burn](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/elemental-burn.md), [gust](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/gust.md), [Thunderous Answer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/thunderous-answer.md), [Wind Step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/wind-step.md).

[Roster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/roster.md) · [Agreed Stability](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/rules/stability.md)

*Heat crawls along the strike, or frost flowers across the skin where it passes.*

**Action:** Main Action

entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Driving Gust

*Dust lifts in a sheet and cloaks snap straight behind their wearers.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-gust


**Action:** Main Action

The printed area attack pushes 1/2/3 squares on Weak/Standard/Strong, away from its origin. Apply Stability to each target. No direct damage; collisions can hurt. A single target is moved once even if it occupies several affected squares.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
